SAME CORRUPTION AS 07-29 AND 07-30 01:50Z — INDEPENDENTLY RE-CONFIRMED FOR THE THIRD CONSECUTIVE NIGHT, STILL HELD BACK, STILL NOT PUBLISHED. The M+ half parses and publishes normally: 40 rows from specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity (fraction x 100), stored at 2026-07-30. The RAID half is the problem: all 40 committed raid "Popularity" rows still carry DPS magnitudes under unit "%" (Blood DK 95300, Frost DK 173900, Unholy DK 170000) - byte-identical to that spec's "95th pct DPS (Mythic)" value, i.e. a prior run merged the `dps` column into the Popularity series. This run's live parse of the SAME field returns correct percentages (Frost Mage 10.28, Unholy DK 10.11, BM Hunter 8.44, Outlaw 0.52), so the upstream field is healthy and the fix is a one-line re-merge. Publishing it would move all 40 rows ~100% and shift the family median, which checkValueMove rejects by design - correctly, that is exactly the units shape it exists to catch - and this run is a `schedule` event with no workflow inputs, so no ack is available. The corrected raid rows were therefore parsed and verified but deliberately EXCLUDED from the apply-metrics input (not merged-then-reverted), leaving the stored corrupt values and their 2026-07-28 coverage date untouched. Coverage is now 2 days stale against a maxAgeDays of 5, so this has roughly 3 more nights before it also trips the staleness gate. ACTION FOR A HUMAN: re-run this workflow with value_move_ack set (e.g. "Archon raid Popularity column-parse corrected, 40 rows rescaled from DPS magnitudes to percent") and the next run lands the fix. Reproduce from props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data[].popularity on the three raid aggregate pages.
